newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee end mixed, Jan/Nov spread narrows.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee end mixed, Jan/Nov spread narrows.

text.p: Robusta coffee futures finished mixed but well above session lows with earlier selling pressuring the nearby November/January spread.
The closely-watched spread, a key indicator of nearby supply availability, narrowed to $78 at the close from the last finish of $95.
"People were just tidying up their books before tomorrow's first notice day for November," said one trader.
Earlier losses were pared by light buying ahead of the long weekend in most European countries for All Saints Day holiday on Friday.
Volume on the exchange reached 4,318 lots, dominated by November and January as players rolled over November positions forward.
Friday is the first notice/tender day for November and traders said the spread could come under further pressure as more coffee is delivered against the spot month.
The contract sank to a session low of $1,460 a tonne before closing $19 lower at $1,463.
Benchmark January closed just $2 down at $1,385 after an earlier move to the day's $1,375 low.
Analysts said the second-position contract looked safe above the nearby $1,360 support.
In other developments, traders said the market was unperturbed by news of the crisis in key grower Zaire.
"I think it has been structured into the market...the market at this stage doesn't seem to take too much notice of it," said one trader.
